title: Proposed canonical Opal result parameter definitions
description: Opal result_parameters authoring contract updated 2026-11-13 from V1_313 evidence and user decisions. Describes the parsed parameter array, not the API string wrapper or entered enforcement responses. Date parameters have numeric min=0 and max=0, meaning no date boundaries; mandatory independently controls requiredness. Final catalogue uses SUMM for manual and automatic summons; legacy SUMA is outside that catalogue. This parameter-only schema cannot enforce result IDs. Null publication semantics remain to be confirmed.
$comment: Required fields, closed properties, conditional options/apidata and closed type/lookup lists are proposed authoring controls based on observed data, not existing database validation. Empty array is allowed pending agreement on null versus empty semantics. Do not load API-generated cy_ definitions back into the canonical catalogue. Unique names and normalized frontend identifier collisions require separate checks.

name.description: Stable machine identifier, scoped to a result; preserve evidenced spellings. Not a closed enumeration.

prompt.description: Display label; no supported maximum label length evidenced.

mandatory.description: Whether an entered response is required; distinct from whether this property is present.

min.description: For date, must be 0 (no earliest date). For other types, type-dependent bound; lookup semantics remain to be agreed. Independent of mandatory.

max.description: For date, must be 0 (no latest date). For other types, type-dependent bound. String sentinels and date-string boundaries are not part of this authoring contract.

language_dependent.description: Used by service Welsh companion generation; not an embedded translation dictionary.

hint.description: Optional guidance for every parameter type; does not control requiredness or validation. If omitted, the reviewed frontend supplies a default date hint.

options.description: Ordered literal options as evidenced; no separate stable option codes in V1_313.

apidata.description: Logical reference dataset key, not an arbitrary URL. Lookup ID/value and filtering contracts remain to be agreed.
